description: Header file defining the CvarElementFormControlSelect class, which extends Rml::ElementFormControlSelect and Rml::EventListener to synchronize a UI select element with a console variable (cvar) in the game engine. It manages attribute changes, child element additions/removals, and events to update the cvar based on user interaction or UI state.

classes.name: CvarElementFormControlSelect
classes.description: A custom UI element class that links a dropdown select control to a game console variable (cvar), allowing synchronization between UI and game settings.

methods.name: CvarElementFormControlSelect
methods.description: Constructor initializing the select element with a tag, setting owner to null and ignore_value_change to false.

methods.name: OnAttributeChange
methods.description: Handles changes to element attributes, specifically updating the cvar name and refreshing the value if options are present.

methods.name: OnChildAdd
methods.description: Handles addition of child elements, caches the owner document, and registers event listeners for show and change events.

methods.name: OnChildRemove
methods.description: Removes event listeners when the element is removed.

methods.name: ProcessEvent
methods.description: Responds to show and change events to update the select value or set the cvar based on user interaction.

methods.name: UpdateValue
methods.description: Synchronizes the select control's selected option with the current cvar value, adding a custom option if no match is found.
